name: AIRDWELLER
summary: Two boxes, one in each hand. Swing them like sticks for a beat of synthesized drums, or let one hand drum while the other strikes, bends and bows a ringing material tuned to the kick.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: Made for two boards, one in each hand, linked by radio; one board alone plays a mixed kit. Swing the board on a short arm: the stroke detector wants a fast turn and a jolt.
status_note: 0.1 passes the simulator and has not been on a board.
